title: AID PM plan decision (P068 E-068-1_2 Step 5)
description: The PM authorization contract for the ONE place in AID where the target branch moves. `plan-merge-to-main` validates a decision artifact against this schema BEFORE any Git action; a decision that fails validation is refused with the target branch unmoved. The artifact binds the PM's answer to a specific plan, a specific plan-final attempt, a specific frozen candidate AND a specific target head — all four, because a decision that names only the plan could authorize a merge of a candidate the PM never saw. `decided_at` is compared against the RUNTIME plan-boundary manifest's `candidate_frozen_at`: a decision made before the candidate was frozen cannot be a decision about that candidate.

decision.description: MERGE authorizes the compare-and-swap merge. FIX returns the plan to PLAN_FIX. ABORT terminates it. Only MERGE ever moves the target branch.

decided_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant. MUST NOT precede the manifest's candidate_frozen_at — a decision older than the freeze describes an earlier candidate.
